stock.description: Zhengye International Holdings Company Limited functions as an investment holding firm, primarily dedicated to the manufacturing and distribution of paper, paperboard, and various paper-based packaging products throughout the People's Republic of China. Its business activities are segmented into Paper-Based Packaging and Corrugated Medium Paper. The company's diverse packaging offerings comprise craft cartons, color-printed cartons, honeycomb paper-based items, corrugated medium paper, along with watermark cartons and box boards. Beyond production, it delivers integrated packaging solutions encompassing design, printing, and logistics, and also undertakes the printing of decorative packaging. Additionally, Zhengye is involved in transportation. Its key customers are manufacturers within the home appliance, fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), and electronic product sectors. The company, founded in 1999, is headquartered in Zhongshan, People's Republic of China.
